limitations: Offscreen serial Metal only; native-window and non-Metal support remain open.
Object-count tiers stress draw submission and scene storage, but do not model gameplay edits or multi-emitter simulation.
Generated geometry uses the existing procedural pine, sphere and cone set; no GLB unique-mesh workload is included.

measurement_storage.raw_samples: Frame-level sample dumps were deleted after extracting the summaries; they were generated locally and are not needed for the recorded per-run medians/p95s.
measurement_storage.summary: Per-run median/p95 summaries and paired comparison reports are embedded in this record.

method: Deterministic clearing-derived scenes preserve the source 276 objects, then add mixed shared/unique pines, rocks and grass. Twenty percent of generated placements lie on the perimeter for independent camera/shadow visibility. At each tier compare baked reference, instancing-only, and culling+instancing.

visual_review.finding: All four tiers were inspected in a baked/instancing-only/culling+instancing contact sheet at the fixed 640x360 grid. No missing geometry or obvious shadow-caster loss was visible. Culling+instancing captures were byte-identical to instancing-only at all tiers; comparison to baked differed at 1, 1, 4 and 0 pixels respectively, with very small mean RGB error. A single 276-tier pixel reached 78/255 channel difference; this remains a reported capture discrepancy, not an exact-parity claim.
